project_type: SAP CAP Node.js multitenant application with vanilla JS frontend
build_system: npm with CAP (cds build --production), MTA deployment for Cloud Foundry
test_framework: No formal test framework detected; verification via cds build and runtime testing
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npx cds build --production' to verify CDS compiles. 2. Check for generated srv/csn.json. 3. Verify no TypeScript/syntax errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: gen/srv/ directory generated by cds build - not checked in
environment_constraints: Worktree is at .worktrees/cap-multitenant-saas. Main repo files (discovery-service, tenant-service) need to be ported. AICONX-brain-hana is existing-service in mta.yaml.
contribution_requirements: Use CDS logging (cds.log). Follow existing patterns for tenant isolation (cds.context.tenant). Use CAP's cds.queued() for async operations. Input validation at service boundaries.
key_patterns: Tenant isolation via cds.context.tenant. Async processing via cds.queued(). SOAP client for PI/PO in srv/utils/pipoSoapClient.js. Vector store in srv/ai/vectorStore.js. Brain config in srv/ai/brainConfig.js.
directory_structure: db/ - CDS data models. srv/ - CAP services and handlers. srv/ai/ - AI/LangGraph helpers. srv/utils/ - Utility modules. mtx/sidecar/ - MTXS sidecar for multitenancy. app/aiconx/webapp/ - Frontend HTML/JS/CSS.
